message_source_quote: the mechanism (stance steering at a mid-depth band making implied concepts readable through the plain J-lens) is the approach described in one of the repo's reading-list papers. My three attempts to find a genuinely different working stance (keep/banish, visualize/mechanical, meaning/literal) all failed, matching that paper's own report that only one of two stance contrasts works.
